name: SPIC Green Energy Co., Ltd.
summary: SPIC Green Energy Co., Ltd. engages in the power generation and heating business in China. The company is involved in power generation, including wind, solar, hydro, thermal, and gas power, as well as distributed energy, biomass, and nuclear energy. It also engages in civil and industrial heating; power plant operation and maintenance; scientific and technological project research and development; and power distribution and sale. The company was formerly known as Jilin Electric Power Co.,Ltd. and change its name to SPIC Green Energy Co., Ltd. in February 2026. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Changchun, China.
